entities.name: Amenhotep, son of Hapu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amenhotep, son of Hapu was an ancient Egyptian architect, a priest, a herald, a scribe, and a public official, who held a number of offices under Amenhotep III of the 18th Dynasty.
